summary: When an exec's driver reports its exit while the exec's own process still runs, the reconciler now watches that process and wakes a pass when it ends, so a step whose exit-code gate waits behind another pending gate sees the exit (and missions and doctor report the impossible gate) without waiting for the minute-long fallback pass

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes. The same terminal observation is recorded, only sooner.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No claim kinds, fields, wire or CLI changes. It reuses the existing in-process exec exit watch that a pending exit-code gate already arms.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the usual daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; reverting the commit restores the earlier wake timing.
